thread:
zoe: Heads-up 1: EdgeWave asked if we can accept gateway-aggregated minute counts (gateway reports sum across N devices) and attribute to individual device entitlements for hourly billing. They ship per-minute totals + optional device-list mapping.

alan: important: gateway aggregates break our device-centric reconciliation. need a deterministic attribution strategy and an audit trail. also cadence for when device list is missing.

rafa: sample payload they propose:
```
{
  "gateway_id": "gw-09",
  "batch_id": "ew-20250720-003",
  "tz": "UTC",
  "minute_aggregates": [
    {"minute": "2025-07-20T15:02:00Z", "total_units": 32, "devices": ["d-11","d-12"]},
    {"minute": "2025-07-20T15:03:00Z", "total_units": 28}
  ]
}
```

zoe: note second minute has no device list. they expect us to use last-known mapping or a fallback attribution if missing.

alan: proposal: ingest gateway minutes as canonical events: gateway_id | minute_utc | total_units | device_list_opt | batch_id. Persist raw. Attribution rules: if device_list present, split evenly unless partner provides weights; if missing, use last-known device_list within preceding 24h; if still missing, mark hour as "aggregate-only" and treat conservatively for billing (credit partner or bill based on historical per-device ratios).

rafa: storage/processing: keep minute-level raw for 14d (longer because partners request audit window), hourly rollups and per-device derived rollups. keep gateway->device mapping table with TTL 30d. Use Kafka topic edgewave.raw and edgewave.attributed for consumers.

ops-bot: Created incident-template "GW-ATTR-RECON" for attribution mismatches.

alan: reconciliation rules (draft):
- If >=50% minutes in hour have explicit device lists: attribute per-device sum and bill.
- If 25-49% minutes have device lists: reconstruct missing minutes using weighted historical distribution (last 7d), cap variance to 15% per-device; flag for partner review.
- If <25% minutes have lists: mark hour as gateway-aggregate-only, bill using conservative historical per-device baseline or credit partner; auto-open ticket for manual resolution.

rafa: partner asks: can we surface a per-device audit CSV they can cross-check? yes but generation costs. propose daily CSV for hours touched yesterday in S3 with provenance columns (source_batch_id, attribution_method, confidence_score).

zoe: legal/finance must sign off on covariance/cap cap limits. need a partner-specific flag to tighten/loosen attribution strategy in contract.

alan: testing: create synthetic feed with mixed device list presence, random missing minute sequences, out-of-order batches, and gateway re-registration where device composition changes mid-hour. Test reconciliation run that recomputes per-device hours from raw.

billing-bot: Created ticket PART-7022 "EdgeWave gateway attribution + audit CSV" assigned to zoe, alan, rafa. ETA 2025-07-25

rafa: action items:
- rafa: PR for ingest schema + kafka topics + raw retention policy (due Fri)
- alan: attribution algorithm PoC + weighted historic estimator (due next Tue)
- zoe: contract flag + partner acceptance criteria + ask finance/legal (due Thu)
- ops-bot: add e2e alert on attribution confidence <0.6 for ops paging (done)

zoe: small decisions so far: use UTC bucketing, store raw minutes 14d, device-mapping TTL 30d, attribution tiers (>=50% explicit, 25-49% weighted, <25% manual). will document confidence scoring.

alan: also: ensure idempotency on gateway batch_id + gateway_id, and sequence numbers if they add them. include provenance fields in attributed events.

rafa: will provide sample CSV format before EOD.

zoe: schedule 30m partner sync for Thurs 10am UTC to agree mapping semantics. tagging @alan @rafa :calendar: 

zoe: thanks all, closing thread pending the sync. :white_check_mark:
